movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hand in hand or arm in arm.

signature_moves.description: Moving in a circle to mimic the sun's path.
signature_moves.name: Clockwise Circle

music_profile.musical_form: Call and response (lead singer and circle).
music_profile.sound_description: A rhythmic, communal sound characterized by vocal improvisation and the vibration of the Kylyhakh technique, accompanied by the metallic twang of the chomus and the strings of the kyrimpa.
music_profile.vocal_style: Improvisational singing with Kylyhakh (vocal cord vibration).

basic_steps: Form a circle with participants holding hands or arms.
Step forward with the left foot.
Perform rhythmic body and arm movements in time with the song.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic, dictated by the lead singer's song.
